title: Woman dies, man critically injured in early-morning I-35 crash in Laredo
excerpt: A 38-year-old woman died and a man was critically injured when a white SUV left northbound Interstate 35 near exit 2 early Sunday morning and struck a light pole, according to KGNS.
content:
A 38-year-old woman died and a man was critically injured in a crash on northbound Interstate 35 in Laredo early Sunday morning, according to KGNS.

The crash happened around 4:30 a.m. Sunday, November 8, near exit 2, KGNS reported. A white SUV heading north lost control, went down an embankment and hit a light pole.

The woman, whose name had not been released, died in the crash. The male passenger was critically injured.

The Laredo Police Department's CRASH team is investigating the crash. No further details had been released as of publication.

Source: KGNS, November 8, 2026.
